title: C Modularization
description: C modularization (cmod arc, C_MODULARIZATION_PLAN.md): a NORMAL C firmware project — it builds with make alone — read by Polari as ATOMS: C functions with declared ports (an empty POLARI_NODE macro or a comment block), the registers / globals / ISRs they touch, pure and ISR-safe verdicts, and their measured cost (text bytes shipped and as a node, the .su stack frame) — derived by parsing (pycparser, in the framework process) into rows and the conformed polari-firmware.json beside the Makefile. No C<->Python transpiling. cmod-0: the UNO firmware template (34 atoms). cmod-1: a no-code graph over atoms (CGraph / CGraphNode / CGraphEdge) renders to plain-C glue committed as a real C project (polari_graph.c/.h + Makefile + the atom files; make alone builds it), proven behaviour-equivalent to the hand-written app on the simavr twin (CGlueBuild).

engines.name: pycparser
engines.note: pycparser 2.21 (BSD-3-Clause) — ALREADY in the framework image (requirements.txt pins it for cffi): the atom parser runs IN the framework process, pure Python, with its bundled PLY preprocessor (pycparser.ply.cpp) and cmod's fake avr-libc headers; 0 MB added. libclang was not taken (D-cmod-1): python3-clang-19 pulls libclang-19-dev + libllvm19 (~470 MB installed) into an engine image

engines.name: avr-gcc
engines.note: the measurement compile only (the Makefile's own flags + -fstack-usage, once as shipped and once -fno-inline) — board's engine, resolved through the BOARD engines seam (BOARD_ENGINES_URL → local binary → prf-board-engines:trixie → topology board.engines → refusal)

engines.name: avr-nm
engines.note: binutils in the same image: per-function text bytes (nm -S --size-sort); the worker's /run lists it

engines.name: make
engines.note: GNU make in prf-board-engines: the proof that a project builds with make ALONE, run on the rung avr-gcc runs on (a remote worker runs single engines → refused, never faked)
